workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 03 Deep Reading for the three selected 2026-08-09 Queue objects after the ordered recovery control plane had restored Reading to Running. Produced three source-traceable Reading Records from merged maintainer implementation evidence. The Langfuse record verifies transactional cancellation of unsettled runs under the same conversation-row lock used for admission while preserving cooperative semantics for already-running workers. The Codex record verifies the short-lived workload-identity exchange primitive, caching, refresh/coalescing, rotation and redaction, while explicitly rejecting the broader child-process stripping claim as unproven by the selected commit. The LangGraph record verifies the persisted plain-value seed migration defect and explains why output correctness could hide an unbounded history replay regression. No Research Analysis, architecture recommendation, article writing or publication was performed.

readings.keyBoundary: Deletion and unsettled-run cancellation share the same durable conversation-row lock as admission; RUNNING cancellation remains cooperative rather than synchronously terminating physical execution.
The selected commit strongly proves the exchange primitive but does not prove the broader child-process credential-stripping boundary described in Queue.

readings.sourceClass: merged maintainer implementation, regression tests and conformance evidence
readings.keyBoundary: A persisted-state migration defect can preserve reconstructed values while violating bounded-replay semantics; conformance protects a backend only when that backend actually executes the suite.
